title: Sunset in Zhangjiajie - where to watch
text: Sunset light turns the quartzite pillars gold and pink. The best spots are Tianzi Mountain's western side with the Imperial Brush silhouetted, Yuanjiajie's Back Garden with side-lit columns, and Tianmen's western route B with views over the city from 1,500 m.

title: Where to catch sunrise in Zhangjiajie
text: Sunrise in these mountains is magical: fog fills the valleys while the pillars pierce through like islands in a white sea. Best spots: Yuanjiajie for classic Avatar views, Tianzi Mountain's Helong Park, and Tianmen east trail. Stay inside the park to catch it on time.

title: Top 7 photo spots in Zhangjiajie
text: The best frames come from: Yuanjiajie (classic Avatar floating mountains view), First Bridge Under Heaven, Tianzi Mountain's Imperial Brush, Bailong Elevator top station, Golden Whip Stream's meeting bridge, Tianmen's Heaven's Gate arch, and the 99 Bends from above.

title: How many days to spend in Zhangjiajie
text: The optimal answer is 4 days. Day 1: Forest Park lower level and Golden Whip Stream. Day 2: upper park - Tianzi Mountain. Day 3: Tianmen Mountain. Day 4: Grand Canyon and glass bridge plus the Fox Fairy show. Park ticket is valid for 4 days - use it fully.

title: Tianmen Mountain: route A or route B?
text: At Tianmen's summit, two loop routes branch from the cable car: East (A) with the Coiling Dragon Cliff glass walk and more dramatic views, and West (B) - gentler and less crowded. Walk both loops if you have time - each is 1.5-1.6 km and together take 2-3 hours.
